name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by right click.
usageSnippet:
<ContextMenu items=[{ value: "copy", label: "Copy" }]>
  Right click here
</ContextMenu>

attributes.name: inset
attributes.description: Emits `data-inset` — indents the entry to align with icon-bearing siblings.

attributes.name: radioGroup
attributes.description: Groups radio items — required for `type: "radio"` entries.

attributes.name: radioValue
attributes.description: `type: "radio"` entries only — this entry's value within its `radioGroup`.

attributes.name: subEntries
attributes.description: `type: "sub"` entries only — the nested submenu's own item list. One level deep: a `type: "sub"` entry inside a submenu's own `subEntries` is not wired (same limit as menubar's submenu).

keyboard.description: Opens the menu at the pointer position, anchored to the trigger region.
Moves the highlight to the next / previous item, wrapping at the ends.
On a submenu trigger item, opens the submenu and moves focus into it.
Closes an open submenu (ArrowLeft) or the whole menu (Escape) and returns focus to the trigger.
Moves the highlight to the first / last item.
Typeahead: jumps the highlight to the next item whose label starts with the typed characters.

accessibilityNotes: The trigger and content wire up `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` automatically via the underlying Zag menu machine — no manual ARIA authoring needed.
Checkbox and radio items expose `role="menuitemcheckbox"` / `role="menuitemradio"` with `aria-checked` reflecting the `checked` field you pass in.
Disabled items (`disabled: true`) are marked `aria-disabled` and skipped by both keyboard navigation and typeahead.

examples.title: Submenu
examples.source:

examples.description: Use a `type: "sub"` entry with `subEntries` to nest a secondary menu (one level deep).

examples.title: Icons
examples.source:
import ContextMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/context-menu/context-menu.marko"; import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko";
Right click here
<@item value="copy"> Copy <@item value="cut"> Cut <@item value="paste"> Paste <@item type="separator"/> <@item value="delete" variant="destructive"> Delete
examples.description: Use the `<@item>` attribute-tag form to combine icons with labels for quick scanning — item bodies render in place of the `label` string.

examples.title: Checkboxes
examples.description: Use `type: "checkbox"` entries for toggles. `checked` is driven by your own state — flip it in the `select` handler.

examples.title: Radio
examples.source:
import ContextMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/context-menu/context-menu.marko"; import type { ContextMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/context-menu/context-menu.marko";
Right click here
examples.description: Use `type: "radio"` entries for exclusive choices grouped by `radioGroup`. Exclusivity is your own state, not automatic — set exactly one entry's `checked` per group in the `select` handler.

examples.title: Destructive
examples.description: Set `variant: "destructive"` on an item to style it as a destructive action.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import ContextMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/context-menu/context-menu.marko"; import type { ContextMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/context-menu/context-menu.marko";
انقر بزر الماوس الأيمن هنا
examples.description: Wrap the trigger in a `dir="rtl"` container for RTL text direction and logical-property layout. Real deviation from upstream: our `Input` type doesn't re-expose the machine's own `dir` prop, so the floating-ui positioner itself doesn't auto-flip placement under RTL the way upstream's demo does.

examples.title: Simple
examples.description: A minimal menu with a `danger` entry styled as destructive.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Set `disabled: true` on an item to skip it during keyboard navigation and pointer input.

examples.title: Compound (attr tags)
examples.source:
import ContextMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/context-menu/context-menu.marko";
Right click here
<@item type="label" label="Actions"/> <@item value="copy" label="Copy" shortcut="⌘C"/> <@item value="paste" label="Paste" shortcut="⌘V"/> <@item type="separator"/> <@item value="delete" label="Delete" variant="destructive"/>
examples.description: Use `<@item>` attribute tags instead of `items=` to compose the menu directly in markup — pass `type="separator"` for a divider or `type="label"` for a group label. Entries render in the order they are written. An item's text can come from either a `label=` attribute or a markup body, whichever you prefer.
